name: [FPS] FLING
desc:
Welcome to Fling! A fast-paced first-person sniper & knife shooter where physics decides who wins.

🎯 Get hit, get launched. Physics-driven ragdoll on every shot.
🧱 Fully voxelised maps. Blast walls, floors, and cover into rubble. Nothing stays standing.
💥 The bigger the hit, the further you fly.
🔫 Unlock new snipers to stand out
🔪Unlock new knives, each with their own unique feel

🏆 Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best shot.
🌍 Cross-platform — PC, console, mobile, and tablet all play together, no matter how you play.

🎮 Controls: Shoot/Stab = Click/RT | Scope = Right-Click/LT | Switch Weapon = Q/Scroll/Y/Bumpers

⚠️ This game is currently in beta. Expect changes!
🚨 Cheaters, exploiters, and alt-farmers will be permanently banned. We do not appeal bans.
